item.title: Jumia ends Algeria operations in latest profitability drive
item.description: Jumia has exited Algeria as part of a wider push to improve profitability, narrowing its geographic footprint while investing in direct sourcing to compete with fast-growing Chinese eCommerce rivals.

item.title: Ethiopia bets on AI with smart police service
item.description: On today's Techpoint Digest, we look at Ethiopia's AI bet with a smart police service, Jumia's exit from Algeria as it narrows its focus, and South Africa's consideration of age limits on social media.

item.title: How to file tax returns for individuals with multiple streams of income
item.description: If you are juggling a 9-5 and a side hustle, here's how to file your taxes before the March 31 deadline.

item.title: StySwap wants to free AI images from the prompt
item.description: Millions of AI images are created every day, often guided by long prompts. StySwap wants to change that, using a single reference image to generate high-quality photos.

item.title: Chowdeck price transparency suit could set a precedent for Nigeria’s food delivery industry
item.description: A lawsuit before Nigeria’s Competition Tribunal alleges Chowdeck inflated menu prices without clear disclosure, raising broader questions about commissions, transparency and pricing in the food delivery industry.

item.title: Sun King moves from solar to smartphones, shaking Kenya’s mobile market
item.description: On today's Techpoint Digest, we discuss Sun King's transition from solar to smartphones, Chowdeck facing a pricing transparency lawsuit, Liberia suspending Starcell's telecom licence, and South African SMEs complaining about Takealot's Buy Box policies.

item.title: Nigerians remix Valentine’s Day in 2026 as Google searches tilt towards friendship and self-care
item.description: Google Search data shows a shift from dinner dates to Galentine’s parties, glow-up experiences, and creative gifts, as Nigerians turn to tech to plan more intentional celebrations of love for Valentine.

item.title: Redtech sets sights on 29 African markets, says mergers and acquisitions on the table
item.description: Redtech, backed by Heirs Holdings, is expanding into 29 African countries and scaling RedPay after processing ₦30 trillion in 2025, with acquisitions also on the table for growth.

item.title: From Papaoutai to Urban Chords: The business and legal stakes of AI music
item.description: Who owns an AI remix? Who gets paid? And can African artistes protect their work from AI? This deep dive examines the business, copyright tensions, and economic realities shaping music’s AI era.

item.title: Ikeja Electric ties power supply to tax IDs for businesses
item.description: On today’s Techpoint Digest, we discuss Ikeja Electric tying power supply to tax IDs, the AI remix that fooled the world, and why Starlink users in Kenya are facing an ID deadline.
